unit.metreOrMinute.meaning: The intentionally shared lowercase notation for a metre or a minute. Multiple valid interpretations can produce multiple answers to one expression.
unit.metreOrMinute.context: Lazy resolution uses constraints across the expression. Multiple valid interpretations produce possible answers. Display identical-looking formatted answers once, without captions, while preserving every underlying interpretation and exact value. For example, 2m * 2 displays one 4m; 10m / 2s displays 5m/s and 300. Independent occurrences may resolve differently. In adjacent duration notation, components may appear in any order and repeat: 30m1h = 90min and 1h30m15m = 105min. Spaces between components do not change these meanings. The all-ambiguous sequence 1m30m, also written 1m 30m, has two accepted readings: a duration sum of 31 minutes and an implicit length product of 30 square metres. This does not introduce addition of adjacent lengths. In the duration parse, the complete sequence is one quantity under outer operators: 1h30m * 2 gives 180 minutes and -1h30m gives minus 90 minutes. The unfinished 1h30 leaves the live result blank until the last component has a unit. Appending a quantity of a different dimension requires an explicit operator: 1h30m2km is rejected with a brief missing-operator diagnostic, whereas 1h30m / 2km is an explicit pace calculation. The exact diagnostic wording is not yet selected. These rules preserve both accepted parses of 1m30m / 1m 30m and do not change ordinary precedence for its length-product parse or implicit multiplication generally. Other mixed-unit sequence boundaries remain open. These examples state values and dimensions, not a new default result notation. Check the supported-unit families after final cancellation: (2s * 3s) / 1s can produce 6s despite an intermediate time square. Discard interpretations with an unsupported final unit and show the remaining valid answers; show an unsupported-unit error only when no supported interpretation remains. Other branch errors, result ordering and copy selection remain open. Do not silently truncate the set of distinct visible answers.
unit.metreOrMinute.location: Unit positions in expressions and results, including nested quantities. The chosen result layout is a horizontally scrolling row without interpretation captions. Completion descriptions are retained separately.
